messages:
Ava Morgan: heads-up — BrightLeaf (cust id BL-231) flagged a gap on their March invoice (INV-2026-042). embeddings show ~1.7k missing rows after an AZ failover at 03:12 UTC. asking for provisional customer credit and a follow-up backfill. @Ravi @Sofia :eyes:
Ravi Patel: ouch. do we know whether those were dropped by ingestion or de-duped by the rate limiter? how many embeds and rough $ impact?
Ava Morgan: looks like a dedupe+ingest window overlap. counts: expected 18,942 vs recorded 17,210 = 1,732 missing. using our pricing tier ($0.20 / 1k) that's approx $0.3464 => round to $0.35 on invoice. SQL I ran:
```
-- sample repro query
SELECT customer_id, count(*) as observed
FROM embeddings_store
WHERE customer_id = 'BL-231' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
Joel Chen: root cause from infra: AZ failover + ip-based rate limiter dedupe window was 15s and our retry logic merged 2 requests as 1. infra changed the limiter config but we need to confirm whether any other customers affected. cc: @Ava to open infra oncall ticket.
Sofia Li: for finance record, propose GL/ledger entry: account GL-4420, memo: "Customer credit - embed undercount - INV-2026-042 - BrightLeaf". create adjustment: -$0.35 (credit). Also please include link to audit query and ticket id. Suggested note text:
```
Adjustment: Credit $0.35 to BrightLeaf (BL-231) for 1,732 missing embeddings. Root cause: AZ failover + rate limiter dedupe. Ticket FIN-3892.
```
FinOps Bot: Created ticket FIN-3892: "BrightLeaf embed undercount during AZ failover" — assigned to Ava Morgan. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/FIN-3892
Ravi Patel: provisional approve :white_check_mark: pending infra confirmation and cross-customer scan. please also run a quick query for same time window across other customers.
Ava Morgan: noted. I'll issue a provisional credit now (manual negative invoice line) and follow with a backfill if ingest replay finds additional rows. @Sofia can you do the GL entry and close FIN-3892 when done? I'll attach the per-customer scan results.
Sofia Li: on it — will post ledger entry id here when completed. thanks for the clear breakdown.
Ava Morgan: thanks team — keeping this thread for the audit trail.
